Hello and welcome to my website! I am currently a student at Case Western Reserve University. I am passionate about systems and infrastructure, planning on becoming a full time sofware engineer where I can work directly with these two sectors.

This past summer, I was a software engineer intern for EquipmentShare working on the financial systems team, where I enhanced job logging and built an automatic job failure triage agent.

In my free time, I love golfing, reading, staying active, and gaming. I am also an avid admirier of art and nature.
